claim: The three observables of a small hand-built flock, measured the short way round the torus.
derivation: Unit headings are (1, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1) and (−1, 0); their mean is (1, 1)/4, so directionalAgreement = √2/4 = 0.353553 (E12).
Nearest neighbours: A→B 1; B→A 1; D→A 2, because 1 − 31 = −30 wraps to +2 (E1); C→B √(8² + 9²) = √145 = 12.041595 (C→A is 12.73, C→D is √202 = 14.21).

Distances below 4.5 pair A–B (1), A–D (2) and B–D (3) across the seam (E1). A and B share heading (1, 0), so they link; D heads (−1, 0), 180° from both, so it links to neither (E14). C is 12 or more from everyone. The clusters {A, B}, {C} and {D} all have fewer than 4 birds: strays, not groups. clusterCount = 0.
Every bird is in a cluster smaller than 4, so all 4 are strays: strayShare = 1 (E18). No group: the flock does not read as one group (O1).
No group (E14), so groupSpread = 0 (E19). No obstacles, so birdsAtObstacles = 0 (E20).
